heading_en: Stress Tests for Assessing Capital Adequacy
summary_ja: 自己資本の充実度を評価するため、経済状況等の悪化を識別し対応能力の評価を含む適切なストレス・テストを実施する。
summary_en: Requires appropriate stress tests to assess capital adequacy, identifying adverse conditions and assessing the ability to respond.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall conduct appropriate stress tests to assess capital adequacy.

The stress tests under the preceding paragraph shall identify the occurrence of events that have adverse effects on the credit risk exposures of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, such as deterioration of economic conditions, deterioration of market conditions and deterioration of liquidity, or future changes in economic conditions, and shall include an assessment of the ability of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach to respond to such adverse changes.
